title: 100% off Xero Software Subscription for 6 Months (New Customers Only) @ Tradiespace
body:
Deal: 100% off Xero Software Subscription for 6 Months (New Customers Only) @ Tradiespace

[CachePC] And as a bonus you get lifetime of 6 monthly price rises to pay 30m to the CEO
[Gflow] Haha fair call, have to call a spade a spade here as I am also a Xero customer. However it is a fantasic product that saves far more money than the monthly subscription cost to businesses.
[jv] 100% Off for 6 Months (New Customers Only)
And then ???
Hostage and annual price increases …
[Nillionaire] I wonder what's the catch within the 6 months too…
[Jimothy Wongingtons] I hate zero but hate myob a lot more (am currently a myob user too and in too deep to take my business elsewhere now..)
[freefall101] Gimme 20 minutes, I'll vibe code an alternative.
[FuRyZ] As someone who works in the IT field, I would not encourage using Xero. Not until they figure out their authentication security systems. To this day they still do not have support for basic industry standards like Single Sign On.
Here is a suggestion from 2013 to enable Microsoft Entra Single Sign On Support, 13 years later… nothing but excuses.
https://productideas.xero.com/forums/967121-users-setup/sugg…
If they are unable to support basic features like this, I would question how robust are their internal security standards.
[askbargain] Since when is SSO a basic feature for SME?
[FuRyZ] It is literally the second highest most voted suggestion on their forums, so it sounds like people definitely want these features.
Many SMEs do in fact use IdP systems like Entra as it gets automatically provisioned with Microsoft 365 business subscriptions. It is far more common than you might think.
[freefall101] Second highest voted doesn't mean much, it's 704 votes.
The problem is still that it's a large implementation yet niche for their userbase. Particularly when ones of that size will be more likely to jump ship to other products that support SSO. Xero has long focused on their accountant network as their main source of clients, for which it has zero benefit.
[FuRyZ] The point being, regardless of if SMEs use these features or not, these authentication systems are relatively universal in enterprise IT security these days. Xero is not some small start up, they are a multi billion dollar company with thousands of employees and millions of customers around the planet.
If a company like Xero which handles sensitive data like financial data is unable to provide these sort of basic features, it is entirely worth questioning the abilities of their developers and just how seriously do they take IT security in general. These are giant red flags.
[askbargain] Who would listen to some IT professional rant about how an enterprise feature not being implemented means that they don't take data security seriously. It's like Xero does not have third party audits or anything. Keep moaning, Xero doesn't care.
If you love SSO and Microsoft so much, use Microsoft Dynamics 365???
